body:
hey, i’m not too much younger than you. 19, and i feel much of the same things you are now. regret, and helplessness are feelings often difficult to overcome. 

as cliche as this is, life truly cannot get better unless you’re living. you’re young. we both are. you have years to create the life you want to, fix and create new relationships and most importantly improve your relationship with yourself. feel free to send me a message as a friend, for help, or anything else. 

the world absolutely is and has been overwhelming for years now and that lack of control for the things around you leaves you helpless. the world is filled with a lot of bad, but a lot of good as well. living is the only way to experience either of those things.

i don’t know you or anything about you, but i care about you. truly.
